text:
maria: Quick sync — dropped a Miro with initial chart sketches and copy ideas. Need decisions for hero chart, headline A/B, and webinar signup routing. Miro: https://miro.com/app/board/xyz

luke: I like the scatter (cost vs median latency) for the hero — it shows tradeoffs. Can we normalize per-1M tokens? Also show p95 or p99 as small label.

carmen: Data note: p50/p95/p99 are from prod traces (Dec–Feb). I can export the CSV. p99 has a couple of GPU-outlier runs flagged — recommend p95 on hero and p99 in the details modal.

aj: Design idea: hero = single clear stat (e.g., "170ms median, 35% lower unit cost") + tiny interactive toggle to switch median/p95. I'll prep 2 colorways and a PNG+SVG.

oliver: On routing — live webinar signups should flow to SDR queue 1 for enterprise follow-up. Others go to growth nurture + console trial. Need an SLA for SDR outreach.

zoe: Growth will own inbound mapping. We need a hidden form field for "expected monthly tokens" to route correctly and a "company size" radio. We'll wire to HubSpot with UTM capture.

maria: Question on price transparency: do we show absolute per-token numbers (e.g., $0.0009/token) on the page or only % relative improvements? Legal flagged risk if numbers are out of date.

carmen: Suggestion: avoid per-token price on hero. Use % savings + a concrete example line: "1M tokens ≈ $X" with assumptions in a footnote/modal. That keeps hero clean and honest.

aj: For assets I propose two final charts: 1) scatter (median latency vs cost per 1M tokens) as hero asset, 2) stacked bar breaking down cost components (compute, memory, infra) per 1M tokens for the modal. I need numbers by EOD Wed to ship.

luke: Also add a small reproducibility callout: model variants, quantization, batch sizes, and instance types used. Link to benchmark scripts repo: https://git.redwood.ai/perf/bench-scripts

maria: Action items: Carmen export CSV + draft footnote text; Aj produce hero PNG + alt; Zoe map form fields to HubSpot; Oliver confirm SDR triage SLA; Luke write chart captions and short copy for hero + modal. Can people ack?

maria: @luke @carmen @aj @oliver @zoe ack pls.

luke: ack :thumbsup:

carmen: ack, will send csv by EOD tomorrow.

aj: ack — design slot booked, variants by Wed.

oliver: ack — I'll confirm SLA and SDR owner by EOD.

zoe: ack, will add hidden fields + share HubSpot mapping doc.

maria: Awesome. One more: webinar CTA should include a short ROI calculator inline so attendees can see estimated monthly cost delta. Thoughts?

luke: love it — small calculator that plugs into the same assumptions as the footnote. Keeps everything consistent.

carmen: I'll include the assumptions (avg tokens per request, sessions per month) in the CSV so growth can surface them in the calculator.

aj: noted — we'll need UI copy for the calculator inputs.

maria: Perfect. Closing this thread for now — we'll reconvene after assets arrive.

All: :thumbsup:
